title: C: Singly Linked List
description: Implement a singly linked list with insert, delete, and print operations.

steps.title: Insert at Head
steps.description: Define a `Node` struct with int data and Node* next. Write `void insert_head(Node **head, int val)` that inserts at the front. Insert 30, 20, 10 and print the list (should output: 10 20 30).
hints: Update head to point to new node.

verification.failureMessage: Print list after inserting 30, 20, 10 at head

steps.title: Delete by Value
steps.description: Write `void delete_value(Node **head, int val)` that removes the first node with the given value. Test by inserting 10, 20, 30, 40, then deleting 20 and printing.
hints: Handle deleting the head node specially.

verification.failureMessage: Delete 20 and print the list (should be 10 30 40)
